description: Admin web: exceljs 4.4.0 (exact, apps/web only, dynamic import), product-xlsx.ts (workbook build + read), product-sheet.ts (CSV reader, image assignment, chunking, issue merge, throttle retry), csv.ts parseCsvTable, new ExcelDownloadButton on the bulk page and catalogue header, rewritten bulk page (preview, Errors + Warnings tables), deletion of product-csv.ts / export-button.tsx and the old CSV template/link/column copy. Includes NITs 4 and 12 (Instructions text), 5 (client half: send weightUnit), 6 (429 wait + one retry for image uploads and chunk POSTs) and 7 (timeout message). Depends on FEAT-002 (shared module) and FEAT-003 (endpoint contract: GET /admin/products/sheet -> SheetExport; POST /admin/products/bulk-v2 { rows, weightUnit? } -> SheetImportResult). Design refs: design.md §4, §7 'buildProductWorkbook' + Instructions, §11 'Web', AC-1/2/14/15/16; design-review.md NITs 4-7, 12.
steps: Dependency: `pnpm --filter @belzo/web add exceljs@4.4.0 --save-exact` (run from repo root). Confirm apps/web/package.json has "exceljs": "4.4.0" (no caret) and pnpm-lock.yaml updated.

csv.ts: add parseCsvTable(text): string[][] (BOM stripped, every record trimmed, blank records KEPT so index + 1 = row number); reimplement parseCsv on top of it with identical behaviour. csv.test.ts: drop the product-csv describe and imports, keep toCsv/parseCsv tests, add parseCsvTable keeps blank records.

product-xlsx.ts (new, apps/web/src/lib/product-xlsx.ts, no React): loadExcel() via `await import('exceljs')` with `default ?? mod`; buildProductWorkbook(data: SheetExport): Promise<ArrayBuffer> exactly per §7 (Products sheet columns/widths/text numFmt '@' for text|sku|image, bold grey frozen header height 32, autoFilter A1:AC1, money '0.00', kg 'General', int '0', percent value pct/100 with '0%' or '0.00%', GST text, list validations on rows 2..max(1000,lastRow+200) for A/L/M and D when categories exist, errorStyle 'warning'; empty export -> the 2 italic yellow EXAMPLE rows; Instructions sheet (col A width 110, bold title, rules 1-19); Categories sheet). Instructions text changes: NIT 4 — insert after rule 16 a rule '16b' (write it as its own row): 'Deleting a row from the sheet does not delete the product or variant. To remove a variant, use Remove in the product editor.'; NIT 12 — append to rule 10: ' Note: the product editor's "Bulk tiers" tool takes % off the Selling Price. The sheet takes % off MRP.' readProductWorkbook(buf): Promise<ParsedSheet> per §4 (sheet pick, header map via mapHeaderRow, unknown/duplicate warnings on row 1, eachRow({ includeEmpty: false }) skipping row 1, oldFormat fatal, >5000 rows fatal, load/ChunkLoad fatals) and returns `weightUnitHint` from mapHeaderRow on ParsedSheet (NIT 5). cellToString per §4 incl. plainNumber.

product-sheet.ts (new, pure): readProductCsv(text): ParsedSheet (record 1 = header, same fatals/warnings, weightUnitHint), imageRefs, isUrlRef, assignSkuFiles(fileKeys, skus) (longest SKU wins; exact-base first then localeCompare), applyResolvedImages, slimChildRow, chunkGroups(groups, { maxRows: 400, maxBytes: 900_000 }) (1,000-row / 900 KB oversize errors), mergeIssues(a, b) de-duplicated by `${row}|${level}|${message}` and sorted by row, productsXlsxFilename(d). NIT 6: export `withThrottleRetry<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, isThrottled: (e: unknown) => boolean, wait: (seconds: number) => Promise<void>, onWait?: (s: number) => void): Promise<T>` — on a throttled error call onWait(60) and wait(60) then retry fn once; a second failure rethrows. (Retry-After is not readable: ApiClientError carries no headers and the API CORS config does not expose it, so the wait is a fixed 60 s.) NIT 7: export `chunkFailureMessage(message)` returning `Import request failed: ${message}. Some of these rows may have been saved — uploading the same file again is safe.` for network errors and 5xx (and the plain `Import request failed: ${message}` for 400/413).

admin-api.ts (NIT 6, behaviour-neutral): make adminUpload throw `class AdminUploadError extends Error { constructor(message: string, readonly status?: number) }` (exported) carrying res.status on a !res.ok response; messages unchanged, so the media picker and other callers behave exactly as before.

excel-download-button.tsx (new 'use client', apps/web/src/app/admin/catalogue/): ExcelDownloadButton({ className = 'btn', style }) -> adminFetch<SheetExport>('/admin/products/sheet') -> buildProductWorkbook -> Blob (xlsx MIME) -> temporary <a download={productsXlsxFilename()}> -> revokeObjectURL; label '⬇ Download Excel', busy 'Preparing…', data-testid 'download-excel', errors in <span role="status" className="prod-form__msg">, 401 -> session-expired text, other -> `Download failed: …`. Enabled for an empty catalogue.

catalogue/page.tsx: replace the ExportProductsButton import/usage with ExcelDownloadButton (same className/style). Delete apps/web/src/lib/product-csv.ts and apps/web/src/app/admin/catalogue/export-button.tsx (git rm, both tracked).

bulk/page.tsx rewrite per §4: remove Row, FALLBACK_SLUG, buildTemplate, templateHref, PRODUCT_CSV_COLUMNS copy, category slug chips/datalist and skuFiles; keep addImageFiles, fileKeyFor and the drop zone. File input accept '.xlsx,.csv,application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet,text/csv' data-testid 'bulk-file'; .xlsx -> readProductWorkbook, .csv -> file.text() + readProductCsv, .xls message, >10 MB message, fatal -> parseErr. groupSheetRows for counts ('N products · M variants in K rows') and client issues; assignSkuFiles fill when all 5 image cells blank; missingFiles; import flow steps 1-4 (image upload loop wrapped in withThrottleRetry with isThrottled = e instanceof AdminUploadError && e.status === 429 and progress text `Server busy — waiting ${s} s…`; parent image failure cascades `Not imported: its Parent row N could not be imported.`; chunkGroups; sequential POST /admin/products/bulk-v2 with { rows: chunk, weightUnit: parsed.weightUnitHint ?? undefined } wrapped in withThrottleRetry with isThrottled = ApiClientError && statusCode === 429; 401 stops with the session-expired text; other failures -> chunkFailureMessage on every row of that chunk; continue). Preview table first 15 rows (Row | Type | Parent SKU | SKU | Title or Size / Colour | MRP | Selling | Stock | Images with ⚠). Result section data-testid 'bulk-result' with ok/bad/warn statuses, Errors table and Warnings table (data-testid 'bulk-warnings'), sorted by row. Copy exactly per §4 (section 1 '1. Download the Excel template' + ExcelDownloadButton + paragraph; section 2 '2. Upload the filled Excel', hint '.xlsx, or CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited) with the same headers', drop-zone sub-text). Keep the page's existing structure/classes.

Tests: apps/web/src/lib/product-xlsx.test.ts and product-sheet.test.ts covering every bullet in design.md §11 'Web' (build -> load checks of sheet names, exact header row, bold/frozen, validations A2/L2/M2/D2, Categories, percent numFmt, kg 'General'; read round trip; text '20%' vs numeric 0.2 with '0%'; numeric SKU/HSN; hyperlink image; empty export -> 2 EXAMPLE rows; non-template and old-format fatals; blank rows 5-6 keep real row numbers; non-zip bytes fatal; '=1+1' literal; 1e21 / 1e-7 plainNumber; readProductCsv cases; chunkGroups cases; slimChildRow; applyResolvedImages; issue merge; assignSkuFiles review example). Add: Instructions sheet contains the 16b text and the rule-10 note; ParsedSheet.weightUnitHint === 'g' for a 'Weight (g)' header; withThrottleRetry retries once on a throttled error and rethrows the second (fake wait, no real timers); chunkFailureMessage wording.

Bundle check (AC-15): ensure no `next dev` on :3000 (else ask), run `pnpm --filter @belzo/web build`. If exceljs fails to resolve, apply the A-13 fallback (`import('exceljs/dist/exceljs.min.js')` + apps/web/src/types/exceljs.d.ts `declare module 'exceljs/dist/exceljs.min.js' { export * from 'exceljs'; }`). Compare First Load JS of `/` and `/product/[slug]` with .agents/tasks/bulk-excel-template/build-baseline.txt: delta < 1 kB; record numbers in findings. Confirm no CSV template link / column list / 'Export products (CSV)' remains (AC-14 web half).

Commit by explicit path (new: product-xlsx.ts(+test), product-sheet.ts(+test), excel-download-button.tsx, optional types/exceljs.d.ts; tracked: apps/web/package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, csv.ts, csv.test.ts, admin-api.ts, bulk/page.tsx, catalogue/page.tsx; deletions via git rm: product-csv.ts, export-button.tsx): `feat(admin): one Excel template for bulk product download and upload`.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm --filter @belzo/web test passes with product-xlsx.test.ts, product-sheet.test.ts and the updated csv.test.ts (AC-1, AC-2, AC-16 covered by tests)

findings: Commit 7970ffe on master (local, not pushed). Staged by explicit path: new apps/web/src/lib/{product-xlsx.ts,product-xlsx.test.ts,product-sheet.ts,product-sheet.test.ts,shared-bulk-sheet.ts}, apps/web/src/app/admin/catalogue/excel-download-button.tsx; tracked apps/web/package.json ("exceljs": "4.4.0", no caret), pnpm-lock.yaml (exceljs tree only), csv.ts, csv.test.ts, admin-api.ts, bulk/page.tsx, catalogue/page.tsx, packages/shared/src/bulk-sheet.ts + bulk-sheet.test.ts; git rm product-csv.ts + export-button.tsx. No untracked pre-existing file staged. A-13 fallback NOT needed: next build resolves import('exceljs') to the browser build; it lands only in async chunk f1aed662 (~935 KB raw), referenced by the webpack runtime's chunk-URL map only. AC-15 ISSUE FOUND AND FIXED: first build after the web changes gave / 119 kB and /product/[slug] 123 kB (+3 kB vs baseline) because bulk-sheet.ts was in the storefront-shared chunk. Two causes: (1) webpack treated bulk-sheet as side-effectful because it imported money.ts (ZERO_MONEY = paise(0) at load) and because webpack's isPure treats array/object literal initialisers as impure; (2) used exports are global, so admin imports through the '@belzo/shared' index activate the index's `export * from './bulk-sheet'` edge in every chunk holding the index. Fix (behaviour-neutral): bulk-sheet.ts now imports nothing (local toPaise = rupeesToMoney's arithmetic, new shared spec pins them incl. a fast-check property) and its array/object consts (SHEET_COLUMNS, SHEET_FIELD_MAX, GST_RATES, TIER_MIN_QTY, OLD_FORMAT_HEADERS, HEADER_ALIASES, TIER_KEYS) are built by /*#__PURE__*/ arrow IIFEs (same values, documented in the module header); web code imports bulk-sheet VALUES via apps/web/src/lib/shared-bulk-sheet.ts (`export * from '../../../../packages/shared/src/bulk-sheet'`), type-only imports stay on '@belzo/shared'. Verified the shim is load-bearing (pointing it back at '@belzo/shared' gives /product/[slug] 123 kB). FIRST LOAD JS (baseline -> after): / 116 kB -> 116 kB (page 2.01 kB -> 2.01 kB); /product/[slug] 120 kB -> 120 kB (6.11 kB -> 6.11 kB); shared by all 87.1 kB -> 87.2 kB (other shared chunks 1.9 -> 2 kB); /admin/catalogue 121 -> 129 kB; /admin/catalogue/bulk 117 -> 124 kB. Storefront chunks for /, /product/[slug], (shop)/layout and /layout contain no bulk-sheet or exceljs code. Interface notes for later steps: ParsedSheet { rows, issues, fatal?, weightUnitHint } is defined in product-sheet.ts (re-exported type from product-xlsx.ts); readSheetHeader/toSheetRow/finishSheet are the shared header->row helpers; applyResolvedImages takes resolve(ref) => string | { error } | undefined (undefined = 'not selected in step 2'); chunkFailureMessage(message, status?) — status undefined (network/JSON parse of a proxy HTML page) or >= 500 adds the 'may have been saved' sentence; withThrottleRetry waits a fixed THROTTLE_WAIT_SECONDS = 60. Bulk page: Import button enabled whenever rows parsed (so grouping-only errors are still reported); 401 on a chunk stops with the session-expired text as a row-0 error; parent image failure cascades to children. AC-14 web half: grep finds no 'Export products', 'Download template', PRODUCT_CSV_COLUMNS, templateHref, product-csv or export-button in apps/web/src. VERIFICATION (one per call, repo root, all PASS): pnpm install OK; pnpm --filter @belzo/shared build OK; pnpm --filter @belzo/web typecheck OK; pnpm --filter @belzo/web test 7 suites / 102 tests (product-xlsx.test.ts 17, product-sheet.test.ts 24, csv.test.ts 7); pnpm --filter @belzo/web lint 0 errors (4 pre-existing warnings in untouched files); pnpm --filter @belzo/web build OK (:3000 not listening). Because shared bulk-sheet.ts changed, also ran: shared test 9 suites / 194 tests, shared lint clean, api typecheck OK (first attempt hit a transient Windows 'batch file cannot be found' shim error, passed on rerun), api test 27 suites / 269 tests. Not verified (manual): opening the file in Excel/LibreOffice (dropdowns), real upload with images against a running API.
